name: RVT / RVT-2
summary: RVT reprojects the point cloud into several orthographic virtual camera views, runs a multi-view transformer attending across them, and back-projects predicted 2D heatmaps into a 3D action, avoiding voxel-grid cost entirely. RVT-2 adds a coarse-to-fine zoom stage reaching millimeter precision on tasks like plug insertion while training in a fraction of PerAct's time.
innovation: Virtual multi-view rendering as a cheap substitute for explicit 3D voxel reasoning.
Coarse-to-fine spatial refinement reaching millimeter precision.
matters: Made 3D keyframe policies practical to train and a standard high-precision baseline.
limits: Depends on good depth and calibration, and inherits PerAct's keyframe abstraction.
lineage: PerAct's spatial action prediction made efficient via multi-view rendering.
